_note: Batch D: 6300 hangover IV drips, 6306 how often to get IV therapy. Both posts are deliberately hedged about what IV therapy can and cannot do, so the evidence cards carry both halves. No prices are baked into any graphic.

cards.subject: hangover
cards.heading: What Exactly Happens to Your Body During a Hangover?
title: What Causes a
Hangover
cards.alt: A hangover comes from dehydration, electrolyte loss, acetaldehyde, inflammation and blood sugar swings

items.label: Acetaldehyde
items.note: The toxic byproduct of metabolizing alcohol

items.label: Inflammation
items.note: An immune response you feel as malaise

cards.subject: hangover IV drip
cards.heading: IV Drips for Hangovers: What’s in the Bag?
title: What Is in a
Hangover IV Drip
cards.alt: A hangover IV drip holds saline, electrolytes, B12 and vitamin C, and sometimes anti-nausea medication

items.label: Saline
items.note: Rehydrates without going through the gut

cards.subject: hangover
cards.heading: Can an IV Drip Actually Cure a Hangover?
title: Can an IV Drip Cure a
Hangover
cards.alt: A hangover IV drip treats dehydration and electrolyte loss but cannot speed alcohol metabolism or replace rest

cards.subject: hangover IV drip
cards.heading: Are There Any Risks or Downsides to Using IV Drips for Hangovers?
title: Risks of a
Hangover IV Drip
cards.alt: Hangover IV drip risks: infection at the needle site, unsterile technique outside a clinic, and overhydration

items.label: Unsterile technique
items.note: The risk rises outside a medical setting

cards.subject: hangover
cards.heading: Other Hangover Remedies: What Can You Do Instead?
title: Treating a
Hangover
Without an IV
cards.alt: Hangover remedies without an IV: water or electrolyte drinks, easy-to-digest food, and sleep with light activity

items.label: Fluids
items.note: Water, sports drinks or coconut water

items.label: Easy food
items.note: Bananas, eggs and toast steady blood sugar

items.label: Rest
items.note: Sleep, then a walk for circulation

cards.subject: IV vitamin therapy
cards.heading: The Core Question: How Often Should You Get IV Vitamin Therapy?
title: How Often to Get
IV Vitamin Therapy
cards.alt: IV therapy frequency by goal: every 2 to 4 weeks for wellness, event-based for travel, monthly for maintenance

items.label: Athletic training
items.note: One or two a month during a block

items.label: After illness
items.note: A single session or short series

cards.subject: IV vitamin therapy
cards.heading: Personalizing Your Schedule: A Simple 4-Step Framework
title: Setting Your
IV Vitamin Therapy
Cadence
cards.alt: Four steps to set IV therapy frequency: clarify the goal, screen and baseline, trial 2 to 3 visits, then maintain or taper

cards.subject: IV vitamin therapy
cards.heading: What Happens If You Get IV Drips Too Often?
title: Getting
IV Vitamin Therapy
Too Often
cards.alt: Too-frequent IV therapy risks vein irritation, fluid and electrolyte imbalance, diminishing returns and dependency

items.label: Fluid imbalance
items.note: A real risk with heart or kidney conditions

items.label: Dependency
items.note: Feeling you need a drip to function

cards.subject: IV therapy
cards.heading: Ingredients Matter: Why Formula Influences Frequency
title: What the Formula Changes About
IV Therapy
Cadence
cards.alt: IV formula drives frequency: B12 monthly or per labs, vitamin C needs screening, magnesium monitored, minerals individualized

cards.subject: IV therapy
cards.heading: When to Adjust Your Frequency
title: When to Change Your
IV Therapy
Schedule
cards.alt: Space out IV therapy when benefits plateau; pause and call for breathlessness, chest pain, fever or a spreading IV site

bad.heading: Pause and call for
items: Warmth spreading from the IV site
